name: toaster
title: Toaster
description: Show a toast from anywhere with toast('Saved'). Mount one Toaster; call toast.success, toast.error or toast.promise from handlers.
a11y: Info and success toasts are announced politely; errors are announced assertively.
F8 moves focus to the notification region; hovering or focusing a toast pauses its timer.
Each toast has a Dismiss button and an optional action button; Escape closes the focused toast.
A stack limit keeps at most three visible by default (older ones wait); motion is removed with prefers-reduced-motion.
Never the only place a critical result appears; keep an inline message too.

props.name: limit
props.description: Most toasts shown at once. Older ones wait out of sight and return when there is room. Default 3.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the stack sits. `end` is the bottom corner at the end of the reading direction. Default "end".

props.name: label
props.description: Names the region for screen readers. Default "Notifications".

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Text of each close button. Default "Dismiss".
